newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-DISCIPLINED UNITED MAKE NO MISTAKES ON WAY TO SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DISCIPLINED UNITED MAKE NO MISTAKES ON WAY TO SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Manchester United reached the semi-finals of the European Cup beating Porto 4-0 on aggregate on Wednesday in the quarter-final.
The second leg in Porto ended in a 0-0 draw after United had crushed the Portuguese champions by four clear goals at Old Trafford two weeks ago.
Porto, making good their promise not to do down without a fight after their dismal performance in the first leg pushed forward from the whistle and had three clear chances in the opening minutes.

Lanky Brazilian striker Mario Jardel sent a diving header wide after just four minutes and should have done better a few minutes later when he was robbed right in front of the goal by by a firm tackle from United central defender David May.
Fellow Brazilian Edmilson Pimenta went close a couple of times in the second half but the United defence, with Gary Pallister outstanding, held firm.
United, in the semifinals of the European Cup for the first time since 1969 also became the first English side to reach the last four of Europe's top club competition in 12 years.
